limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, rest, travel or weather.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
The NHL source carries no betting lines, so market comparisons, selections and ledger rows are unavailable.

NHL: the stats API carries no betting lines, so market fields are null. Margins are goals with every overtime or shootout decision recorded as a one-goal margin; regular season and playoffs are included, preseason and All-Star excluded; the feed has no neutral-site flag (Global Series games abroad count as home games).
